column1: A ball rolls horizontally. A beam of light becomes linearly polarized after passing through a polarizer. A beam of light strikes the water surface at a certain angle and becomes polarized. A cube slides on a smooth horizontal surface. A small ball rolls down an inclined plane. A beam of light splits into two polarized beams after passing through a birefringent crystal. A beam of light reflects and refracts at the interface between air and glass, causing partial polarization. A laser beam changes its polarization direction after passing through an optically active substance. A small ball moves uniformly in a circular track. A beam of light forms an interference pattern after passing through a grating. A charged particle moving in a magnetic field deflects its path. A beam of light passes through an LCD screen, displaying different polarization effects. A ball bounces in the vertical direction. A beam of light changes its polarization state after passing through layers of transparent media of varying thickness. A beam of light shows intensity variation after passing through a rotating polarizer. A beam of light is completely blocked after passing through two crossed polarizers. A point moves in uniform circular motion on a circumference. A beam of light disperses and causes a change in polarization after passing through a prism. A beam of light changes its polarization direction after reflecting off a mirror. A small ball moves in circular motion on a rotating platform. A beam of light changes its polarization state after reflecting off a series of inclined plane mirrors. A beam of light experiences scattering and polarization changes when passing through an inhomogeneous medium.
